posts.en:
dsh-issue-tracker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Jira Cloud issue-tracker integration exposing eight model tools for issue search, project and transition lookup, creation, updates, comments, and transitions; writes are opt-in and support dry-run.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7cb188fe0c4d7227d654.html
